title: check_markup input
description: Judges markup as written (Spec 038 MG-2): give the fragment as text. It derives the Ero instances (every fm-<ero> with its props, slots, texts and label) and the Sxablono instances (their regions found by the region markers of get_sxablono) and answers with them, with the judgement of check_usage on the Ero instances in rezulto and, where the markup holds a Sxablono, the page rules (regions, one primary action, landmarks) apart in sxablonoRezulto. A fragment without an Ero instance is judged with zero instances. Call it before handing over markup.

fragment.description: The markup: a fragment, or a whole document whose <html lang> gives the language.

lingvo.description: The language of the page's texts where the fragment carries no <html lang> (ISO 639-1, the first two letters count).

aspekto.description: The Aspekto every Ero instance is shown in; check_usage validates it.

dimensioj.description: Dimensio values every Ero instance is shown under, e.g. viewport=compact; check_usage validates them.
